author: thomaspd
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:** PTHR11475

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):** TPO gene in human P07202

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**  Annotation is correct but could be much more specific. Currently only annotated with a very general MF (peroxidase activity) and no BP. The entire clade of vertebrate TPOs could be given more specific annotations (MF iodide peroxidase activity; BP hormone biosynthesis or more specific; this is involved in thyroid hormone biosynthesis T4, specifically the step that transfers iodide to thyroglobulin). It looks like we should already have decent EXP annotations for the pig ortholog; see https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P09933/entry.

* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
title: PAINT issue: thyroid peroxidase

author: marcfeuermann
body:
Hi Paul, 
Thank you for sharing this. The corresponding vertebrate section of PTHR11475 actually contains many ancient duplications that lead to MPO, LPO, EPX, TPO, PXDN, ... Surprisingly, there are only a few primary annotations, so to avoid errors, we have remained cautious by using the general MF term. 
For the TPO node (PTN002607745), indeed, only pig had the appropriate primary annotations:
MF: GO:0004447 - iodide peroxidase activity 
BP: GO:0006590 - thyroid hormone generation
This was sufficient to annotate the entire node.
I checked to see if we had a more granular BP GO term, which was not the case. GO:0006590 seems okay but we can discuss with Pascale to see if we could improve GO at the term level.
Also, I found it annoying that we had no relevant primary GO annotations for human, which is why (as a bonus) I took the liberty of creating the terms mentioned above for human from PMID:31629072.
I've also updated a few other annotations when possible.
Cheers,
Marc.

author: pgaudet
marcfeuermann
body: If you mark the new terms as obsolete before they are even available for PAINT... then my annotation to GO:0004447 - iodide peroxidase activity was valid, and there's nothing to do. I'm closing this ticket. Thanks, Marc.
